name: ops-watch
description: One watch round run by an agent, for manual or explicit use: the server's own model-free watch loop (HARNESS_OPS_WATCH_SECONDS, default every 60 s) is the default way to watch, and starts an agent only for a new or escalated incident. This workflow, scheduled (every N minutes, in an unattended dontAsk session), runs an agent every round: evaluate every alert rule now, and when something fires, open or update an incident for it and tell the user (notify_user). Read-only apart from the incident record.

firing.description: how many alerts fire now, outside maintenance windows

check.title: Check alerts
check.prompt:
Run ops_check (with service "{{input.scope}}" when that is not empty). Do not change any system and do not investigate at length.
If alerts fire outside maintenance windows: for each affected service, look for an open incident (incident list) and add a timeline entry (kind detection) with the alert lines, or open one (severity by the alert: critical -> sev2, warning -> sev3). Then call notify_user once with a short message: which alerts fire, on which services, and the incident ids. Errors (rules that could not be evaluated) count as alerts about monitoring itself.
If nothing fires, do not notify.

Report: the ops_check summary line and what you did.
